page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8s.4xlarge is a virtualized server instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical Intel Xeon 8369B processor cores operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz with two threads per core. The instance provides 32 GB of system memory, yielding 2 GB per core, alongside 48 MB of L3 cache and hardware extensions including AVX-512 and VNNI. Graphics acceleration is supplied by a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU resource equivalent to one-third of a full card, delivering 8 GB of VRAM. The server operates without bundled local NVMe storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance evaluations place this instance in the middle 50th percentile across tested CPU, memory, and application benchmarks. Multi-threaded CPU performance achieves a stress-ng score of 28120.76 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 12813.0, supported by multi-threaded bzip3 decompression of 82.89 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth testing records 77.1 GB/sec for uncached large block reads and 51.61 GB/sec for writes. The allocated fractional A10 GPU supports lightweight machine learning execution, processing prompts at 1154.59 tokens/sec and generating text at 243.2 tokens/sec on a 135M parameter LLM, while reaching 32.25 prompt tokens/sec and 12.06 generation tokens/sec on a 7B parameter LLM.

By partitioning the NVIDIA A10 GPU into an 8 GB virtual workstation slicing profile, the instance offers cost-efficient GPU access for entry-level accelerated tasks without requiring a dedicated full physical GPU. However, the 2:1 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and complete absence of local disk storage present resource bottlenecks for memory-dense or high-I/O data processing applications. The hardware architecture and virtual GPU allocation make this instance appropriate for lightweight LLM inference, virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), moderate graphics rendering, and general compute workloads requiring basic acceleration.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8s.4xlarge is a virtualized server instance equipped with 16 vCPUs across 8 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores operating at 2.9 GHz, 32 GB of system memory, and a fractional 0.3333 NVIDIA A10 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. Built on the KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture, it features AVX-512 vector extensions and 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, though it lacks local NVMe storage. Benchmarks place its compute, memory bandwidth, and execution throughput within the average 50th percentile relative to peer servers. The fractional GPU allocation provides a cost-effective environment for lighter graphics acceleration and small model execution, supporting 135M model text generation at 243.2 tokens/sec and 7B model generation at 12.06 tokens/sec. This instance is suitable for lightweight LLM inference, virtual workstation environments, 3D graphics rendering, and general workloads needing moderate acceleration.
